title: Tool-list conformance test
spec: Add test/mcp/conformance.test.ts and src/mcp/schema.ts: a zod schema for the tools/list response and a check that every tool's inputSchema is a valid JSON Schema object with `type: "object"`, that names match ^[a-z]+(\.[a-z]+)*$, and that descriptions are under 200 chars. Also validate that the official tclk-mcp's tool names (frame.encode, frame.decode, ...) do not collide with ours.
done: The conformance test passes against u-mcp-01's server and fails on a planted bad tool.
